title: Force on axis
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be the correct magnitude of the force on the horizontal axis (9mg).

title: Condition for no force
description: Essential: The final answers for part (2) must correctly state the velocities of balls A and B when the axis is free from force.

title: Centripetal force at highest point
description: Important: For part (1), correctly applies Newton's second law for centripetal force to ball A at the highest point to find the angular speed.

title: Force balance for axis-free condition
description: Important: For part (2), sets up and solves the system of force equations for both balls when the net horizontal force on the axis is zero.

title: Angular-linear velocity relation
description: Important: Correctly relates the found angular speed to the linear velocities of balls A and B using v = ωr.

title: Free-body diagram application
description: Optional: Correctly identifies and labels all forces (tension, weight, centripetal) on the free-body diagrams for both balls.

title: Sign error in centripetal direction
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly assigns the direction of centripetal acceleration or net force for a ball at a given position.

title: Incorrect radius for centripetal force
description: Pitfall: Uses an incorrect distance from the axis O as the radius for calculating centripetal acceleration for either ball.
